obj.label: dag yig nyer mkho bsdus pa (4433)

relations.support_notes: The text is ascribed to Blo ldan shes rab (ID: 3786) by dNgos grub rgya mtsho (ca. 1580) and A kya Yongs ’dzin Blo bzang don grub (ca. 1760–1830) alias dByangs can dga’ ba’i blo gros. But van der Kuijp contests this authorship based on the spelling of some words in the manuscript and the occurrence of the expression hor ’dra, the first use of which he situates around 1240–1350 (<<van der Kuijp 2003 [FZ6N88AU]>>: 392, referred to in [KHA9ZVGP]: 18, n. 55).

comments:
Explanation in 7-syllable verses and a few passages in prose at the beginning of each of the five sections announced in the programmatic verse:  the numerical determination of graphs and ligatures, the particles, what is to be accepted or rejected about prefixes and postscripts, and various classifications of additional matter (see [UBZQCTMF]: 436).
The author refers to three unidentified "kha cig," whose views are refuted.
